purpose: Teach: プログラマー/ユーティリティ/短大/本学/南側/伝送/陳列/懲戒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、プログラマーの採用を強化しろ
lines.style: Direct command, clipped delivery. Opens with authority. No room for negotiation. Measured pace, steady gaze.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバーのユーティリティ機能を整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll upgrade the server utility infrastructure.
lines.style: Immediate, decisive affirmation. Slight forward lean on the response. Competent tone—showing he's already thinking through the implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、短大卒の人材も積極的に採用しろ
lines.en: Also actively recruit junior college graduates.
lines.style: Same commanding tone as the first line. Slightly softer gate on 'also'—adding to the directive without repetition. Still decisive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本学卒の役員も増やしたいですね
lines.en: Understood. We should expand our executive ranks with alumni too.
lines.style: Slightly lighter than before—a small note of agreement or insight underneath the compliance. Still professional. A beat of genuine thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社屋の南側に新しい入口を設けろ
lines.en: Install a new entrance on the south side of the building.
lines.style: Firm directive. Concrete, physical instruction. Same authoritative pace as previous commands. No inflection that invites discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。データ伝送経路を冗長化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement redundancy in our data transmission routes.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment, professional cadence. The words come quickly—executing on instruction. No hesitation, no elaboration beyond necessity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 陳列棚のレイアウトを変えろ
lines.style: Short, sharp directive. Opens with crisp attack. Business-like, no explanation needed. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員規程の懲戒事項を明確にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll clarify the disciplinary provisions in the employee handbook.
lines.style: Final affirmation—slightly weighted with closure. Professional, thorough. A touch of resolution, as if closing a section of the meeting.
